title: DeepSeek V4 preview changes agentic coding and migration planning
summary: Official DeepSeek docs describe V4 preview, 1M context, agent integrations, new model names, and a 2026-07-24 retirement date for legacy API model names. This is a migration article candidate because builders need a verification plan, not a hype summary.

title: X algorithm claims need a cautious public-evidence table
summary: Live X search clusters can expose repeated questions about ranking, reach, and algorithm changes. Treat the feed as discovery only, then use public repositories and source-backed analysis before publishing any claim.

title: Use Codex use cases as article endings, not just inspiration
summary: The Codex use-case library includes computer use, learning reports, saving workflows as skills, verified operations, and creating CLI tools. Those use cases can become the ending of each technical article: a workflow artifact readers can reuse.
evidence: existing Agentic Codex Dev Skill case study

title: CV trend posts should ship a reproducibility gate
summary: Computer-vision papers and demos often spread quickly, but a portfolio article is stronger when it ships a reproducibility gate: dataset notes, metrics, failure cases, and a small reviewed artifact.
evidence: CV Repro Lab public case study
